signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a sign-in link.
signIn.sent: Link sent. Check your email and open the link in it (it is valid for 15 minutes).

error.lichessEmailInUse: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in by email or with Google, then connect Lichess in settings.
error.linkExpired: The link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
error.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

onboarding.title: Welcome!
onboarding.intro: Tell us what to call you and which language to show the site in.
onboarding.displayNameHint: Others will see this name. You can change it later in settings.

coachMode.title: Coach mode
coachMode.intro: With Coach mode on you can invite players and keep them in groups.
coachMode.offNote: Switching Coach mode off revokes your open invites and keeps your groups.

myCoaches.title: My coaches
myCoaches.empty: You are not linked to a coach yet. A coach can send you an invite link.
myCoaches.unlinkConfirm: Unlink from this coach? {name} will no longer see your data, and you will leave their groups.

providers.title: Sign-in methods
providers.intro: You can always sign in by email too: we send the link to {email}.
providers.lichessUnlinked: For your security, we disconnected Lichess: it was connected before your email address was confirmed. If this Lichess account is yours, connect it again.

error.notFresh: For your security, sign in again before connecting or disconnecting an account.
error.linkedElsewhere: That account is already connected to another mychess account.
error.generic: That did not work. Please try again.

export.title: Your data
export.intro: Download all your account data as a JSON file.
export.notFresh: For your security, sign in again before downloading your data.

delete.title: Delete account

items.account: your account, display name and email address;
items.providers: your connected Google and Lichess accounts;

delete.irreversible: A deleted account cannot be restored. We will email you a confirmation.
delete.typeName: To confirm, type your display name: {name}
delete.typeEmail: To confirm, type your email address: {email}

account.deleteNameMismatch: The name you typed does not match your display name.
account.deleteEmailMismatch: The address you typed does not match your email address.
account.localeInvalid: Choose a language: Lithuanian or English.

displayName.tooLong: A display name can be at most 50 characters.

groupName.tooLong: A group name can be at most 60 characters.

coach.title: Coach dashboard
coach.notCoach: Switch Coach mode on in settings first.
coach.stillLinked: Coach mode cannot be switched off while players are linked to you.
coach.groupLimit: You cannot create any more groups.
coach.inviteLimit: You have 50 open invites. Revoke one or wait until one expires.
coach.notLinked: This player is not linked to you.

players.title: Players
players.empty: No player is linked to you yet. Create an invite and send the link to a player.
players.unlinkConfirm: Unlink this player? {name} will leave your groups, and you will no longer see their data.

invites.title: Invites
invites.intro: An invite link is valid for 7 days. A personal invite can be accepted by one player, a group invite by many.
invites.linkOnce: Copy the link now: it cannot be shown again.

invite.groupRequired: Choose a group for a group invite.
invite.groupInvalid: Choose a group from the list.

magicLink.subject: Sign in to mychess

deleted.subject: Your mychess account has been deleted
deleted.body: Your account and all its data have been permanently deleted.

moveInput.label: Type a move
moveInput.unknown: There is no such move in this position.
